name: zenmode
description: Connect Grok Build to your ZenMode account through ZenMode's hosted MCP server. Read LinkedIn outreach campaigns, contacts and conversation history, add or remove leads, pause or exclude a contact, and change campaign targeting. Read only unless you choose Read and change. No tool sends a LinkedIn message or connection request. Sign in to ZenMode on first connect. Needs a ZenMode plan (Practitioner and above).
